📒 *known issue recurrence — `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout`*  (occurrence #270 — **10-fire resurface**)
Channel: alert-frontend-errors  •  alerts in group: 2  •  DD monitor: 77419271 last_triggered 17:33:12Z

This is the chronic Datadog "Unusual number of XHR errors" cluster — Ocelot timeouts in `ms-gateway-api` proxying to `microservices.methodlocal.int` (sync-util / preferences / account paths). DM was last sent at 13:15Z today (4h53m ago, under 24h window) — surfacing now because every-10th-occurrence rule tripped.

Today's fire rhythm: 13:15Z (occ 261-262 9-msg → DM), 15:09Z (occ 263-265 3-msg → suppress), 16:09Z (occ 266-269 9-msg → suppress, LARGEST cluster of day), 17:29Z (this — 2-msg). Cluster size is decaying (9 → 3 → 9 → 2) but the every-1h cycle hasn't broken — chronic.

Playbook (KB): 1) Confirm chronic baseline by comparing ES Ocelot.Responder.Middleware Warning volume vs 24h ago (delta < 20% = chronic); 2) Aggregate timeouts by RequestPath — if dominant paths are all upstream microservices.methodlocal.int, it's pool-level; 3) Check `ki-dns-microservices-method-int-pps-quota` first (DNS bursts present here as Ocelot timeouts); 4) If DNS clean, identify slow microservice via Ocelot config.

Note: KB entry's `fix_status` is still `active-outage-deploy-regression-2026-06-04` from yesterday's NCNG-1445 swat. Yuri reverted at 14:44Z and Melo confirmed "Rollback is complete" at 15:24Z (yesterday) — the deploy-regression is over but residual XHR-error volume hasn't fully decayed. Worth updating `fix_status` to `chronic-residual` if the every-1h cycle persists tomorrow.
